title: Mineral Resources Data System compact CSV
source_date: Metadata snapshot 2016-03-15; ZIP HTTP last-modified 2022-08-23; individual observations vary and are often older
coverage: Worldwide multiple commodities; strong US bias; includes mines, prospects, occurrences and plants
resolution: Points with highly variable accuracy; decimal coordinates are not precision guarantees
status: Acquired; normalized Cu/Sn subset; plant rows excluded separately
license: Metadata access/use constraints: none. Attribute USGS and retain record references; no USGS endorsement implied.
biases: Incomplete discovery/reporting, major geography bias, sparse fields, duplicate district/site records. Source A-E score measures information quality/completeness, not a calibrated ore probability. No numeric grades in this compact digest.
role: Broad reported occurrence baseline including small/undeveloped sites; not a grade or historical-accessibility map

title: Spatial Database for a Global Assessment of Undiscovered Copper Resources, SIR 2010-5090-Z
source_date: 2016 compilation of regional assessments; individual assessment years preserved
coverage: Global porphyry and selected sediment-hosted copper systems: 192 + 48 permissive tracts, 2199 + 1200 observed points, plus 21 Precambrian reference points
resolution: Source warns against use/display at scales more detailed than 1:1,000,000
status: Acquired and exported with metadata, source references and topology flags
license: USGS data. Metadata requires describing modifications and not misrepresenting USGS approval; acknowledgment appreciated. Preserve scale and accuracy disclaimers.
biases: Only two major Cu systems, incomplete global geological coverage and discovery bias. Potential may be assessed to 1 km (porphyry) or deeper sediment-hosted scopes, not surface availability. Eleven source polygon geometries fail the local validity check.
role: Expert permissive background eligibility and observed hotspots; do not reuse economic filtering or model resource probabilities as spawn probabilities

title: Sediment-hosted copper deposits of the world, OFR 03-107
coverage: Worldwide sediment-hosted copper points, host units, minerals, deposit grades and references
status: Acquired as supplementary raw CSV/shapefile tables; not merged to avoid duplicate inflation
license: USGS; included of03-107.met is the authoritative metadata. Website-linked standalone metadata XML returned 404.
biases: Older and overlaps the 2016 assessment; do not stack independent weights for copied records
role: Cross-check minerals, host rocks and references, especially source discrepancies

title: A global database of porphyry copper deposits and prospects
coverage: Global porphyry copper sites with tectonic origin, age and available grade-tonnage
resolution: Deposit/prospect points; attachment metadata not acquired
status: Release and DOI metadata verified; ScienceBase attachment access returned HTTP 403; NOT acquired
biases: Porphyry only; grade/tonnage availability varies; contemporary economic estimates are not early ore grades
role: Priority newer replacement/augmentation after attachment download is available

title: World Tin and Tungsten Deposit Database, Open File 7688
publisher: Geological Survey of Canada / IAGOD working group
source_date: 2014 publication; mostly current to early 2008 with limited 2014 Canadian updates
coverage: Worldwide primary, placer and volcanic-associated tin/tungsten deposits; detailed host rocks, mineralization style, tectonics and historic resource figures
resolution: Deposit/group points; per-record accuracy requires archive
status: Publication contents verified via indexed government PDF; archive NOT acquired. Old GEOSCAN DNS unavailable, new repository SSL failed; direct PDF download yielded an HTML archive notice.
license: Crown copyright stated; free download is not an explicit redistribution license. Confirm archive terms before shipping derived data.
biases: Literature/expert compilation, dated and weighted toward significant known deposits; resource estimates are historical and not necessarily modern reporting-code compliant
role: Highest priority global tin geology source, but no acquired geometry or probability claimed

title: Tin Deposits in the United States
coverage: More than 120 US mineral regions, mines and deposits with tin enrichment, including sites without demonstrated economic potential
resolution: Mixed deposit/district granularity; verify attachment before use
status: Release metadata verified; data attachment not acquired in this pass
license: USGS release; verify exact attachment metadata before redistribution
biases: US only; inclusion explicitly does not establish economic potential
role: Targeted measured tin enrichment/low-grade study rather than assuming every occurrence has recoverable tin

title: Tin, Professional Paper 1802-S
coverage: Global tin mineral systems and metallogenic provinces; primary and secondary sources
status: Official abstract/model description reviewed; spatial polygons not supplied here
license: USGS publication; preserve attribution and any figure-specific third-party credits
biases: A geological model supports inference, not proof of ore in every granite or every stream
role: Review tin-fertile evolved intrusions, contacts, veins, greisen/skarn/replacement systems and source-linked placers

title: Nordic Ore Deposit Database and metallogenic belts
source_date: Current portal; update dates must be checked per downloaded release; Russia updates suspended since 2022-02-24
coverage: Nordic region including Estonia and Greenland; mines, occurrences, grades, host geology and metallogenic belts
crs: Older FODD map service reports EPSG:25834; newer download CRS not verified
status: Portal, service metadata and download landing URLs verified; files not acquired
license: Specific NODD terms permit non-profit extracts with owner acknowledgment, prohibit sale of data and request additional permission for extended uses; not a blanket open redistribution license. https://www.gtk.fi/en/disclaimer-read-this-first/
biases: Regional and mixed-age estimates; online service and downloadable vintage may differ
role: Useful northern-Europe refinement; keep separate from automatically redistributable USGS baseline

title: OZMIN mineral deposits and Australian geoscience data discovery
source_date: Live services and dated downloadable snapshots differ
coverage: Australian mineral deposits, occurrences, resources and related geological context
resolution: Deposit/occurrence data and heterogeneous regional geological layers
status: Official discovery path verified; catalog request blocked and no current file/API layer acquired
license: Check selected current release and component dataset terms; no blanket license inferred
biases: National rather than global; major-resource and map-label filters omit smaller occurrences
role: Priority Australian tin/copper supplement including subeconomic demonstrated resources where explicitly recorded

title: Penzance geological memoir, sheets 351 and 358
coverage: Detailed Cornwall geology, mineralization, historical extraction and weathering
status: Primary text reviewed; historical overlay references, no map copied
license: Cite source; map/figure reuse requires checking BGS terms rather than treating this as an open GIS package
biases: One well-studied district cannot calibrate the whole world
role: Prototype historical and source-to-placer logic; do not infer entire-country fertility
